searchParameters.q: Newcastle disease virus aerosol survival relative humidity 10%

answerBox.snippet: The survival of aerosolized Newcastle Disease Virus (LaSota strain) was examined under 15 conditions of temperature and relative humidity (10, 15, 20, 25, and 30 C, each at low (20-30%), medium (50%) and high (80%) relative humidities (RH)) in the rotating drum system. Virus survival was best at 10 and at low RH.
